correctness.rationale: Concavity yields a global one-half Holder bound, monotonicity of phi(r)/r, Gamma at least one, and the explicit Larsen weight Q(z)=4K^2/(1+|z|). These verify Theorem 2.6 directly. Differentiation of the logarithmically damped family gives the stated concavity and the exact W^{1,2} threshold gamma>1/2.

originality.rationale: Larsen 2026 supplies the two-variable theorem and pure square-root examples, while classical work supplies modulus, factorization, and Sobolev sufficient conditions. Targeted searches did not locate the concave square-root reduction or its logarithmically damped family. The full Yamada 1986 factorization theorem was not inspected, so equivalent older coverage remains a residual risk and the claim is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result converts a two-variable strict-comparison test into a transparent one-variable shape criterion and exhibits an explicit continuum with strict comparison, failure of the classical modulus test, and an exact Sobolev transition at gamma=1/2.
